audience: End users and decision makers in small and medium-sized businesses that use Microsoft 365.
notRelevant: IT operations, monitoring and reporting for administrators

baseValue.0: No relation to Microsoft 365 for this audience (e.g. Dynamics 365, Power Platform, developer or government-only topics).
baseValue.4: Microsoft 365 topic, but no core product is the subject (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Planner, Microsoft 365 in general).
baseValue.7: A core product is the subject of the item.

actionBonus.1: Concrete benefit for users (new feature they can use, practical tip) or a recommendation without a date.
actionBonus.2: Action or preparation needed, with a date more than 7 days away.
actionBonus.3: Acute: deadline within 7 days, or something stops working or is currently disrupted.

excluded: True if the item belongs to a 'not relevant' topic, even if it mentions a core product.
